value.rationale: Natural random-formal-context fixed-point count: in the near-complete regime missing-incidence density vanishes, yet the number of concepts grows exponentially with explicit positive typical rate. A computable convergent colored-tree series, effective local MIS recursion and nontrivial cubic correction answer the motivated scale question, not an arbitrary special-number exercise.
